parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, protection, and housing for internal components such as the magnetron, turntable, and wiring.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is made of tempered glass with a metal or plastic frame, allowing users to view the food while it cooks.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a shield to contain microwaves and provides access to the cooking chamber when opened.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates on a hinge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls consist of plastic knobs and buttons located on the front panel of the microwave.
parts.Functional_description: They allow the user to set cooking time, power level, and other functions.
parts.Movement_description: The knobs rotate and buttons depress to send input signals to the microwave’s control system.
